snapshot.methodology: Polygon tetuBAL at post block; look-through only where it clears >10 BAL @50%: Tetu xtetuBAL vault; old/new tetuBAL-BPT pools; old gauge stakers; GaugeDepositor → Tetu BPT vaults. Dropped no-op look-throughs: new BPT vault’s own tetuBAL shares; new-gauge EOAs other than GaugeDepositor.

residuals.label: Unattributed / dropped no-op look-throughs (new vault tetuBAL, new-gauge EOAs, vault dust)
